mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO weather_warning_info ( prsntn_sn, ttl, prsntn_tm, rlvt_zone, content, time_txt, maas_obnt_dt ) VALUES
( #{item.prsntnSn}, #{item.ttl}, #{item.prsntnTm}, #{item.rlvtZone}, #{item.content}, #{item.timeTxt}, #{item.maasObntDt} )
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE ttl = VALUES(ttl), prsntn_tm = VALUES(prsntn_tm), rlvt_zone = VALUES(rlvt_zone), content = VALUES(content), time_txt = VALUES(time_txt), maas_obnt_dt = VALUES(maas_obnt_dt)
mapper.select: SELECT prsntn_sn AS prsntnSn, ttl, prsntn_tm AS prsntnTm, rlvt_zone AS rlvtZone, content, time_txt AS timeTxt, maas_obnt_dt AS maasObntDt FROM weather_warning_info ORDER BY prsntn_tm DESC
